features.name: any_comment_numbered_list
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment contain a numbered list (lines beginning 1., 2., etc.)?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads. Return null if missing or malformed. For each comment string, find line-start markers with regex r'(?m)^\s*(\d{1,2})[.)]\s+\S'. A comment has a numbered list if it has markers with number 1 and number 2 (both present, 2 appearing after 1). Return 1 if any comment qualifies, else 0 (empty list gives 0).

h0: any_comment_numbered_list has no association with the probability that the OP changed their view (delta).
h1: Discussions with any_comment_numbered_list=1 have a higher probability of OP view change than those with 0.
note: Persuasiveness is operationalised as the dataset outcome delta (OP changed view); association only, not causal. Numbered-list detection is a mechanical regex on current comment text: it requires line-start "1." and "2." markers, so inline lists ("1) ... 2)" within a sentence) or non-line-start numbering are missed. Comments are not linked to the delta-awarding comment, so a list comment may not be the persuasive one. Row-level "any" is used because per-comment outcomes are not supplied. Text may contain outcome announcements; the regex is not filtered for them.
